information: * Make sure to be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate. * Attend the tutorial session if you're new to WCA competitions or unfamiliar with its rules. * Bring a government ID card for verification if it's your first time participating in a WCA competition. * Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers. * Addition of any New Round on spot will be done only under the discretion of the Delegate with consultation of Organising team. **Non-Veg Food is strictly prohibited in the Venue Premises.**
